parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans status, but the dossier documents traveller-facing institutional exposures: statutory single-sex code interprets services by biological sex, transport police strip-search by birth sex, prison placement contested, foreign gender certificates suspect, and hospital-ward exclusion is signalled. An outed visitor can face invasive searches, denial of women-only or medical facilities, harassment, and unsafe custody. Anti-trans media and falling index show hostile climate, though no organised trans violence is documented. Rule-of-law protection from gender-reassignment discrimination remains, but it is partly neutralised by state enforcement of birth-sex rules. Elevated risk, lower edge.
